findings.title: Exploratory false-weather overlay
findings.claim: Exploratory overlay only: the mobilization/cavalry image, future promise, and final ghurur can be imagined as an imposing dry cloud, expected rain, a sign of arrival, and deceptive appearance.
findings.mechanism: The HFT joins the thin mountain-like cloud facet on j-l-b, the rain-portent facet on kh-y-l, the expected-future branch on waʿd, and the final ghurur verdict. Before: “The cavalry image and the promises are separate instruments of force and speech.” After: “They also form a false-weather front: an imposing sign appears to promise life-bearing arrival, but the apparent cloud carries no water and resolves as غرور.”
findings.reader_payoff: A surprising focus-root constellation becomes visible while leaving the military and promise readings intact.
findings.containment: This is surprising because cavalry and mobilization are not weather glosses. It remains valid as a focus-anchored branch constellation: a mountain-like cloud without water, a rain portent, a promising sign, and unstable glitter converge on four focus roots. Render it only as an exploratory metaphorical overlay, never as a replacement translation.
